name: cronus

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test "dist/unit/*.mjs" && vitest run
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run migrate && wrangler deploy
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply cronus --local && wrangler dev --test-scheduled

description: A cron scheduler on Cloudflare Workers that calls your URLs on time, written in Squint.
